description: This file defines the 'Edit' feature in the Users domain, including data models, validation, and the handler for updating user information in the database.

classes.name: Edit.UserData
classes.description: Data transfer object for user details that can be updated.

classes.name: Edit.Command
classes.description: Request object encapsulating user data for the edit operation.

classes.name: Edit.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validation logic for the Command to ensure user data is provided.

classes.name: Edit.Handler
classes.description: Handles the user edit command, performing database update and returning the updated user info.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the command to update user information, including validation, fetching current user, updating fields, hashing passwords if provided, and saving changes.
